items.text: A sports career as a player is open to very few people and ends early, so the sensible plan keeps education going, uses official pathways, avoids pay-for-selection trials and builds a backup in coaching, analysis, fitness or management from the start.
Train seriously, but treat study and a backup skill as part of the plan, not as a failure.
Check the official association for your sport and be careful with private trials that charge to select.
